title: Stefanos N. Fragkoulis
text:
This is the personal website of Stefanos N. Fragkoulis.
Hello World!
I’m a Bioinformatician/Data Analyst with a PhD in Biology and two MSc degrees—one in Environmental Biology and the other in Applied Bioinformatics & Data Analysis. With over 10 years of experience in data analysis, I have worked on 3 national and 3 international Research Grants in the fields of natural and biological sciences. My expertise spans Genomics, Systems Biology, Environmental Science, and the integration of biological and environmental data.
In my current role as a Science Officer and Panel Coordinator for Life Science Committees, I have honed my skills in research evaluation, panel coordination, and framework development to ensure the highest standards of scientific rigor. I also hold certifications in Project Management and Data Science (R & Python) and have contributed to 12 peer-reviewed publications and 11 conference proceedings.
I’m eager to apply my experience and skills in data-driven biological research and bioinformatics to make a meaningful impact in the industrial sector, particularly in biotech, conservation, and environmental industries. I’m always open to connecting with professionals and organizations looking to push the boundaries of research and innovation.
